lines.trans: Do you understand what the matter is? Just look at this.

words.gram: в чём дело = what the matter is

lines.trans: He brought this into the classroom. And he was showing it to everyone.
Oh, and where did you get this? Were you spying on Inga Evgenyevna?
Do you think this is a real photograph? No, only the face here is mine.
He made this on the computer, in Photoshop. And he disrupted the lesson!
Slavik, do you hear what the teachers are saying?

words.gram: diminutive of Вячеслав, used as address

lines.trans: What are we to do with him? He already has a failing grade for the term.
Excuse us, we will fix everything.
You should follow your sister's example! Your sister is smart, serious, and hardworking.
By the way, how is her health?
Who, Yulya? Fine, thank you.
So the operation went well?

words.gram: то есть = so, in other words

lines.trans: What operation?
It must be something serious for you. The girl has been lying in the regional clinic for two weeks already!
Yes, you know, it is a very serious operation. We'll fix everything. Goodbye!
Get up, Slavik! You'll tell your father everything yourself at home.

meanings.note: 'брать' alone often means this, in talk about officials

examples.trans: We have to take all the money.

meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: 'взять на работу' = to give someone a job

вставать.gloss: to get up, to stand up

meanings.note: out of bed or from the floor

examples.trans: Come on, Tuzik, let's get up!
I get up at seven in the morning.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: 'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular

examples.trans: In short, girls, listen to me.

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.
The main thing is, you keep him at home.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.en: to fix, to correct, to put right

examples.trans: Excuse us, we will fix everything.

examples.text: Ученик быстро исправил ошибку в тетради.
examples.trans: The pupil quickly corrected the mistake in his notebook.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know
in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Девочка уже две недели лежит в областной клинике!
examples.trans: The girl has been lying in the regional clinic for two weeks already!

examples.text: Врач работает в новой детской клинике.
examples.trans: The doctor works at the new children's clinic.

examples.text: Он это сделал в компьютере, в фотошопе.
examples.trans: He made this on the computer, in Photoshop.
A new computer stands on the desk.

meanings.en: by the way, speaking of which

examples.trans: Oh, by the way, I almost forgot.

meanings.en: to lie, to be lying down, to rest

examples.text: Такие люди должны лежать в особенном месте!
examples.trans: Such people should lie in a special place!
The book is lying on the table.
He has a very kind face.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: Well, probably somewhere in the archive.
He has probably already come home.

meanings.note: неделю = for a week; через неделю = in a week

examples.text: Девочка уже две недели лежит в областной клинике!
examples.trans: The girl has been lying in the regional clinic for two weeks already!
He went to the regional capital.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: That's what the operation is called.

meanings.note: fleeting е in all declined forms: отца, отцу...

examples.trans: The Godfather is a famous film.
I love our town very much.

подглядывать.gloss: to spy, to peek, to peep

meanings.en: to peek, to spy on (+ за + instrumental)

examples.text: Ты что, подглядывал за Ингой Евгеньевной?
examples.trans: Were you spying on Inga Evgenyevna?
It is not nice to peep through the keyhole.

meanings.en: to show, to display, to broadcast on TV

examples.text: Его весь день показывают по телевизору.
examples.trans: They show him on TV all day.

meanings.note: понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I want to go to the sea, you know?

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look

meanings.note: брать пример с + genitive = to follow someone's example

examples.text: Ты бы брал пример с сестры!
examples.trans: You should follow your sister's example!
What did you bring into the flat?

пройти.gloss: to go through, to pass; to come along

meanings.note: 'Пройдёмте' = let's go, an official's polite order
ironic: Сталину расскажите = tell that to Stalin
+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.text: Я приехала к очень серьёзному человеку.
examples.trans: I have come to see a very important man.
He gave our sister a flat.

сорвать.gloss: to disrupt, to ruin; to tear off

meanings.en: to disrupt, to ruin (a lesson or plan)
meanings.note: сорвать урок = to disrupt a class

examples.text: Шум в коридоре чуть не сорвал занятие.
examples.trans: The noise in the corridor almost disrupted the class.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.trans: Your sister is smart, serious, and hardworking.
He is a very diligent pupil.

meanings.note: 'а то' at the start of a sentence: 'а то мы уже начали беспокоиться' = we were starting to worry

examples.text: А то мы уже начали беспокоиться.
examples.trans: We were starting to worry, you see.
There's someone here to see you.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

examples.text: Ты же у нас такая умная!

meanings.note: in уроки учить / делать уроки, plural

examples.text: Славик, ты слышишь, что учителя говорят?
examples.trans: Slavik, do you hear what the teachers are saying?

examples.text: Наш учитель истории очень интересно рассказывает.
examples.trans: Our history teacher tells stories very interestingly.

examples.text: А можно с вами фотографию, пожалуйста?
examples.trans: May I take a photo with you, please?

examples.text: Он это сделал в компьютере, в фотошопе.
examples.trans: He made this on the computer, in Photoshop.

examples.text: Эту картинку явно сделали в фотошопе.
examples.trans: This picture was clearly made in Photoshop.

meanings.en: school term, quarter of the school year

examples.text: У него уже два в четверти.
examples.trans: He already has a failing grade for the term.

examples.text: В этой четверти у неё только пятёрки.
examples.trans: In this school term she has only top marks.

meanings.note: я что-то вижу = I see something
colloquial, used as an adverb: что-то я не вижу = somehow I don't see it
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
